source: Actual frozen Core187 Host4 ProgramSnapshot/c6_phys_program.rs definitions; source inventory separate and not an independent expectation.

rowGrammar: for each ctor: text(name,Template), count(fields,max_arity), for each field: text(name,Template), one TypeExpr

tableRule: Immediately after entry, each of22 tables in the declared order emits one usize count prefix followed by exactly that many complete rows. A zero table still consumes its count prefix. Repeated rows remain distinct ordered rows, never deduplicated. No alignment/padding/table directory or skipped table.

primitiveGrammar.usize: One exact nonnegative native integer within chosen64-bit host usize; no scalar-string/Boolean/float conversion.
primitiveGrammar.raw_u128: One exact nonnegative native integer <=340282366920938463463374607431768211455; constant n is not usize converted.
primitiveGrammar.slice: Raw start then len, both usize. Preserve nonzero-start empty slices; no normalization or invented slice-membership/end constraint from another codec.
primitiveGrammar.option: None→[0,0]; Some(index)→[1,index]. Some0 distinct from None.
primitiveGrammar.text: One usize byte length followed by every canonical UTF8 byte as its own u128 lane. Zero-byte string still consumes its length lane; two-byte Unicode scalar and two ASCII chars each encode2bytes but distinct bytes.
primitiveGrammar.count: One usize length, then row repetitions; selected count bound is the declared field, including zero bounds for zero input tables.

declarationRule: Preserve declaration/template order, names and parameters, ctor order/names and fields order/names. TypeExpr Apply writes its tag/name/arity before every child in original left-to-right order. Apply arity0 is a complete node. Separate positive budgets: all names-table UTF8 bytes cumulatively<=max_name_bytes, every declaration/parameter/ctor/field/TypeExpr name byte cumulatively<=max_template_bytes, every TypeExpr node across all fields/declarations cumulatively<=max_type_expr_nodes. No reset perrow/declaration. Declaration parameter count, fields perctor and Apply arity<=max_arity; ctors perdecl<=max_names.
positiveDomain: Both specimens are structurally constructed owned ProgramSnapshot carriers, not Admitted/ProgramView membership or execution/reachability.
All usize fields/row counts/string lengths/sums/cursors fit64-bit host; raw u128 fields fitu128. Booleans are native Boolean and mapped0/1.

Each table count and nested declaration/TypeExpr count meets its existing selected codec cap; positive text/node cumulative budgets fit; no arithmetic overflow or truncation. Those are external premises, not a new validator/refusal or resource policy.

Native input strings are valid Rust String; paired byte wires are exact canonicalUTF8. Preorder typed field tokens are one complete finite tree with Apply arity/child grouping. No UTF8 decoder or token-admission policy is being implemented.

Entry/IDs/index fields are represented as hostusize values. Actual codec does not claim active-row membership/typechecking/resolution; all-empty table specimen is valid only in this representation sense.
Exact positive input stream is complete with no trailing lanes and correct source-declared tags/headers. Malformed/refusal/error precedence cases are deliberately outside this task.
Caps are direct synthetic C6PhysCaps inputs, not derived/authenticated original admitting-layout limits; no producer authority or capraise is inferred.
wholeObservationMeaning: Complete typed byte/preorder projection of entry+all22tables, every encoded lane, all22 raw table counts and stream/table/row/string cursor positions, no field/table filter or observer-selected subset.
scopeLimits: Positive Core codec counterpart only; no inference about handwrittenPROGCTX validator parser/circuit/admission/refusal/auth semantics.
Byte/preorder adapter is externally declared lossless projection; native Rust UTF8/AST correspondence is conditional on that relation, not directly executed or proved by Quint.
No semantic program validity, StepInv/live state/authority/finance/cost/native/SDK/refinement/EARS closure; retain G/E/D/N and25OPEN refinements.
No universal codec theorem or exhaustive allvariant test coverage follows from two finite specimens; grammar describes all variants but cohort covers only listed actual input cases.
